subject.title: fix(agents): avoid symlink-follow in auth.json bootstrap

question: Should OpenClaw treat a dangling auth.json symlink as unsafe and replace the link with a local 0600 file during credential bootstrap?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it removes a symlink-target creation behavior in a credential path, so owner intent is needed for the security-versus-compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Symlink Hardening
options.body: Approve replacing dangling auth.json symlinks during bootstrap as the desired credential-store security behavior, then merge once CI gates are clean.

options.title: Require Compatibility Accommodation
options.body: Ask for a narrow compatibility note or additional coverage if maintainers want to preserve any supported custom symlink setup.

options.title: Pause For Broader Auth Policy
options.body: Defer this PR if credential-store symlink behavior should be decided as part of a larger auth storage policy change.

recommendation.title: Accept Symlink Hardening
recommendation.body: Approve replacing dangling auth.json symlinks during bootstrap as the desired credential-store security behavior, then merge once CI gates are clean.
